text: I grew up as Batang Pasig. As we live near the Pasog River, in Manila. Every time there's flood after a typhoon, I would often see helicopters flying above our neighbourhood and dropping relief goods. Kahit neck deep ang baha dati, & not possible to reach us, we still get help.

The flood is approaching the middle of our street (we're at the higher end). The flood pump didn't work this time in Pasig. Lord, please make the rains stop and floods subside. Keep safe everyone.  🙏🏻 #PaengPH

Let's all be careful .. 
Marikina River is increasing fast ..

Those who live in low-lying areas, evacuate if necessary .. 

Pepare and evacuate those who will affected by the flood ..
